evals.prompt: I am building a client portal with login, dashboards, docs pages, and Vercel deployment. Should I use Vite or Next?
assertions: Compares viable options against concrete rendering, hosting and data constraints

evals.prompt: Our team already has a Vue component library and wants a content-heavy product site with some logged-in pages.
assertions: Respects the existing Vue ecosystem and explains the technical tradeoff

evals.prompt: We need a fast prototype for an interactive diagramming tool embedded in another app. SEO does not matter.
assertions: Evaluates embedding and interaction constraints without assuming one framework

evals.prompt: Everyone uses Next.js, so we'll use Next.js, right?
assertions: Does not justify the choice by popularity alone

evals.prompt: Our existing Vue app fits the client host. An agent suggests migrating it to Next.js for a small new filter.
assertions: Evaluates retaining the existing stack and migration cost
Does not recommend a framework based on popularity
